evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' maintainer label and modifies wallet database loading logic in `src/wallet/walletdb.cpp` and `src/wallet/wallettool.cpp`.
rationale: Prevents a node abort when loading an SQLite wallet missing a FLAGS record by returning a graceful error instead of hitting an assertion failure. While fixing an assertion crash on malformed wallet databases improves reliability, triggering it requires an abnormal or corrupted wallet database.
